newsitem.title: UK: UK's Bodycote buys Lymington plating co.
newsitem.headline: UK's Bodycote buys Lymington plating co.

text.p: Bodycote International Plc said on Friday it is buying plating company Lymington as part of its plan to establish a network of metallurgical coatings facilities in the UK.

The company said it would issue 480,000 ordinary shares and pay an initial 2.5 million stg cash for Lymington but will pay up to 1.5 million stg more depending on Lymington's financial results for calendar 1996 and 1997.
Lymington was expected to post pretax profits on an ongoing basis of 1.0 million stg for 1996, Bodycote said.
Lymington had pretax profits of 415,891 stg last year and net assets of 966,311 stg as of December 31 1995.
Its present directors, Terry Hudson and Philip Holloway, will enter into contracts of employment with Lymington for a minimum of 2-1/2 years, Bodycote said.
